## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

The *Vibhattihāravibhaṅga* (“Conveying an Analysis: Analysis”) is the eleventh section (Ne 11) of the *Nettippakaraṇa*, a late canonical or paracanonical work of the Pali tradition [SuttaCentral]. It provides the analytical exposition (*vibhaṅga*) of the *vibhattihāra* (the mode of conveying an analysis or classification), which constitutes one of the sixteen interpretive conveyances (*hāra*) foundational to the hermeneutical method of the *Netti* [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral notes one modern translation of the text [SuttaCentral].
No cross-language parallels in Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan are recorded by SuttaCentral or DharmaNexus [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus nevertheless identifies extensive Pali-internal text reuse, calculating 221 shared passages across nine other texts [DharmaNexus]. The greatest concentration of matches appears in commentary and subcommentary literature, specifically the *Nettivibhāvinī* (73 matches, longest between §4.4–4.5 and §787_3–787_6), the *Nettippakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā* (39 matches, longest between §5.1–5.3_2 and §168_2–168_5), and the *Nettippakaraṇa-ṭīkā* (9 matches) [DharmaNexus]. It also exhibits significant text reuse with the canonical *Aṭṭhakanipāta* of the *Aṅguttara Nikāya* (AN 8; 25 matches, longest between §7.1_2–7.1_4 and AN 8 §36.4.1), the *Netti*’s own *Sāsanapaṭṭhāna* (Ne 37; 25 matches), the *Peṭakopadesa* (19 matches with *Sāsanapaṭṭhānadutiyabhūmi*, Pe 2; 9 matches with *Hārasampātabhūmi*, Pe 8), as well as Abhidhamma commentaries including the *Dhammasaṅgaṇi-aṭṭhakathā* (13 matches) and *Abhidhammāvatāra-purāṇaṭīkā* (9 matches) [DharmaNexus].
